newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan monopoly says Ecuador oil reserve promising.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan monopoly says Ecuador oil reserve promising.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum said on Tuesday its joint exploration investment in Ecuador's Block 17 oil field yielded significant results with at least 50 million barrels oil in reservoir.
"A recent well drilled at Block 17 showed the area's oil reserve exceeds 50 million barrels," Chinese Petroleum vice president Hsieh Shih-hsiung told Reuters by telephone.
He said more findings and development were likely as joint venture partner Elf Aquitaine of France explores the field further.
Block 17 oil field is in eastern Ecuador.
Chinese Petroleum and Elf each hold 30 percent stakes in the joint exploration venture while Brazilian oil company Braspetro owned 40 percent.
